call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Event Contracts Explosion (>6x YoY to $173M) & Post-Election Longevity
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Vlad, event contracts surged over 6x YoY to $173M this quarter. How much of this volume is tied to the upcoming U.S. Presidential election versus permanent macro and single-stock event contracts, and what does the post-election decay curve look like?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: CEO Vlad Tenev emphasized that while the U.S. election is driving peak engagement, Robinhood has rapidly expanded event contracts into economic data releases (CPI, Fed rate cuts), sports outcomes, and quarterly earnings prints. The platform is seeing 65% of event traders cross-trade equities and options, transforming prediction markets into a sticky top-of-funnel customer acquisition channel that continues well past the election cycle.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Cryptocurrency Revenue Decline (-55% YoY) vs Multi-Asset Diversification
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Shiv, crypto transaction revenue declined to $120M from $268M last year and $134M in Q1. Given the broader crypto market backdrop, how should we think about crypto's contribution to total revenue going forward?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: CFO Shiv Verma explained that Robinhood's multi-cylinder strategy is designed precisely to absorb crypto cyclicality. Despite crypto revenue softening -55% YoY, total net revenue reached an all-time record $1,424M because Options (+31% YoY to $399M), Event Contracts (up >6x to $173M), and Equities (+41% YoY to $121M) more than offset the drop. Robinhood is now running 14 business lines at $100M+ annualized revenue, insulating margins.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: October Net Deposits Surging Past $13B & Wealth Management Strategy
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: You disclosed that October Net Deposits have already topped $13 billion month-to-date, including $6 billion from the Dell family into Trump Accounts. What does this mean for your average account size, margin lending demand, and long-term net interest income?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: Vlad Tenev noted that the Dell family contribution marks Robinhood's emergence as a premier platform for high-net-worth wealth preservation. Bringing massive institutional deposits into Trump Accounts significantly lowers Robinhood's effective cost of capital, drives premium Gold subscription uptake, and creates a large, sticky pool of interest-earning assets that will support net interest revenue even in a declining Fed funds rate environment.
